name: OpenWhispr
description: Search, read and create OpenWhispr dictation notes, meeting transcripts, dictionary words and snippets from Claude or Cursor via MCP, REST API or CLI, for people who dictate.

skills.name: Search Notes
skills.description: Searches notes with hybrid semantic and full-text search, and lists, reads, creates, updates or deletes notes and folders.

skills.name: Read Transcripts
skills.description: Gets transcriptions and note transcripts with speaker-attributed segments and timestamps, including SRT and VTT output.

skills.name: Manage Dictionary
skills.description: Lists, adds, updates and deletes custom dictionary words so names and jargon are spelled correctly in dictation.

skills.name: Manage Snippets
skills.description: Creates, updates and deletes snippets, the trigger phrases that expand into longer text while you dictate.

skills.name: Transcribe Audio
skills.description: Transcribes a short audio clip with OpenWhispr Cloud and returns the transcript in the same request (beta).
